source_caption:
Despite being a quintessential New York City film deeply rooted in the hyper-specific, cutthroat culture of Manhattan hedge funds, writer-director Chloe Domont’s feature debut wasn’t actually shot in the United States. To maximize their limited independent budget, the production took place almost entirely in Belgrade, Serbia. The art department meticulously constructed the sleek, glass-walled trading floor and the couple’s claustrophobic apartment on Eastern European soundstages, flawlessly fooling audiences into believing the intense psychological thriller was playing out directly in the heart of the American financial district.

Fair Play (2023), written and directed by Chloe Domont, starring Phoebe Dynevor, Alden Ehrenreich, Eddie Marsan, Rich Sommer. An unexpected promotion at a cutthroat Wall Street hedge fund pushes a young, secretly engaged couple’s relationship to the brink, unraveling their romance as ambition, jealousy, and toxic gender dynamics poison their personal and professional lives.

source_details.title: Fair Play
source_details.synopsis: Fair Play is a 2023 American erotic psychological thriller film written and directed by Chloe Domont in her feature directorial debut. Starring Phoebe Dynevor, Alden Ehrenreich, Eddie Marsan, and Rich Sommer, the film focuses on a young couple whose relationship begins to unravel following an unexpected promotion at a cutthroat hedge fund firm. Rian Johnson was an executive producer on the film. Fair Play premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 20, 2023, and was released in select theaters on September 29, before its streaming release by Netflix on October 6. The film received positive reviews from critics.
